title: tc-compact-breakdown
description: One total split into its parts: a big number, a stacked bar and a ranked list, with an optional period switch.

heading.description: The heading, and the group's name

items.description: The parts of the shown period – the list ranks them by value

periods.description: Options of the period switch – no switch when left out

period.description: The chosen period id; unset is the first period

delta.description: Change against the previous period in percent, e.g. 12.4 or -3 – shown as a small pill

totalLabel.description: Text under the big number while nothing is hovered

id.description: Stable key across periods – defaults to the label

color.description: Any CSS color – defaults to shades of the accent, then grays
